contract: The estate ships docker compose with a mag service (Linux container, 0.0.0.0 bind, NAME != SERVICE lesson banked 09-30) and an OpenClaw /board/inbox bridge. STRANGER AUDIT the container surface: (1) what does an attacker on the LAN get in 3 moves? (2) secrets into containers - .env handling, volume mounts, what is overmounted? (3) the cheapest hardening that is not security theater. Under 400 words.
